bukhari:5224.note: Asma: early marriage to az-Zubayr; date stones from his land about two miles; the Prophet offers her a ride; Abu Bakr sends a servant for the horse

bukhari:4200.note: Anas: Khaybar; Safiyya first assigned to Dihya al-Kalbi, then came to the Prophet, who made her freedom her dowry

bukhari:3895.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:3895.note: Aisha: shown to the Prophet twice in a dream, in a piece of silk, 'this is your wife', he uncovered it and it was her; if it is from Allah it will be done

bukhari:3662.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:3662.note: Amr ibn al-As asks who is most beloved; answers in order Aisha, her father, Umar

bukhari:4750.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:4750.note: Aisha: the slander (ifk), Abdullah ibn Ubayy leads it, her month of illness, revelation of her innocence; quotes 24:11-20 and 24:22

bukhari:6503.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:6503.note: Sahl: the Prophet held up two fingers; he was sent and the Hour is near

bukhari:3636.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:3636.note: Ibn Mas'ud: the moon was split in two in the Prophet's lifetime; 'Bear witness'; no mountain in the text

bukhari:3637.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:3637.note: Anas: the people of Makkah asked for a sign and he showed them the splitting of the moon; no further detail

bukhari:80.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:80.note: Anas: signs of the Hour: knowledge taken away, ignorance established, wine drunk widely, open fornication

bukhari:4635.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:4635.note: Abu Hurayrah: the Hour not before the sun rises from the west; all will believe, then belief does not benefit one who had not believed before; no statement about repentance closing

bukhari:2732.grader: Sahih al-Bukhari (compiler's criteria; sunnah.com shows no separate grade)
bukhari:2732.note: Same page as 2731: Hudaybiyyah, slaughter and shave, Umm Salama's counsel

tirmidhi:3187.note: Abu Hurayrah: the Beast with the ring of Sulayman and staff of Musa; brightens the faces of believers and marks the noses of disbelievers; weak per Darussalam, al-Tirmidhi called it hasan

tirmidhi:3211.note: Umm Umarah al-Ansariyyah asks why women are not mentioned; Qur'an 33:35 revealed; no Umm Salama in this report
